title: LB Jacob Rodriguez would be an excellent addition to the Broncos defense

sources.title: LB Jacob Rodriguez would be an excellent addition to the Broncos defense
sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos may have interest in is former Texas Tech linebacker Jacob Rodriguez. He is a 6-1, 231-pound linebacker prospect who is one of the more talented and productive linebackers in the entire 2026 NFL Draft. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Rodriguez ranked as his 64th overall player in […]
